evidence.evidenceSnippet: 포스텍 구성원을 위한 멀티 LLM 기반 생성형 AI 서비스 'POSTECH AI'은 단순한 질의응답 서비스를 넘어섭니다. 이 플랫폼은 ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude 등 세계 최고 수준의 모델을 한곳에 담아, 사용자가 연구와 업무 목적에 따라 최적의 모델을 선택할 수 있는 폭넓은 환경을 제공합니다. 그뿐 아니라 사용자가 입력한 데이터가 외부 모델의 재학습에 절대 활용되지 않도록 설계되었습니다.

claims.claimText: POSTECH says it discussed data security, data sovereignty, operating structure, scalability, and governance before later implementation tasks including POSTECH AI.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: MOU 체결 이후 포스텍은 AI를 대학 전반에 내재화하기 위해 필요한 데이터 보안과 주권, 그리고 운영 및 확장 구조에 대해 심도 있게 논의해 왔습니다. 이는 AI가 대학의 교육·연구·행정 전반의 데이터를 다룰 때 어떤 원칙과 책임 체계 아래 움직여야 하는지 점검하는 과정이었습니다. 기술을 도입하기 전, 그 기술이 안전하고 책임감 있게 작동할 수 있는 거버넌스(Governance)를 먼저 다진 것입니다. 이는 이후 POSTECH AI 오픈을 포함한 여러 실행 과제들의 기준점이 되었습니다.

coursework.en: POSTECH Library learner guidelines specify that generative AI permission varies by course; students must verify each syllabus and cannot assume blanket permission.
coursework.zh: 浦项科技大学图书馆学习指南明确说明：生成式AI的使用权限因课程而异，学生必须查阅各科教学大纲，不得擅自默认可以使用。

exams.en: POSTECH academic dishonesty rules list having another person sit an examination and sharing or copying examination answers among prohibited acts. Check the course’s specific AI rules separately.
exams.zh: POSTECH学术不端规则列举的禁止行为包括请他人代考以及在考试中展示或抄看答案；具体AI使用规则须另查课程要求。

disclosure.en: Library guidance says that when AI is quoted in formal writing, such as a research paper, the AI citation must be included.
disclosure.zh: 图书馆指引规定，在研究论文等正式写作中引用AI内容时，必须注明AI引用信息。

privacy_data.en: Library guidance warns that entering personal details such as names or phone numbers into AI can expose them to others and advises care with personal information security.
privacy_data.zh: 图书馆指引提醒，向AI输入姓名或电话号码等个人信息可能泄露给他人，应注意个人信息安全。

approved_tools.en: POSTECH Library provides academic search and discovery services including Primo Research Assistant; campus-wide enterprise AI licensing or a centralized multi-LLM platform remains an unverified gap.
approved_tools.zh: 浦项科技大学图书馆提供包括Primo研究助手在内的学术检索辅助服务；全校级企业AI许可或统一多模型平台属于未核实政策缺口。

research_publication.en: POSTECH research ethics rules say authors should be researchers who made academic or technical contributions to the research and exclude people who made no such contribution.

academic_integrity.en: A student objecting to a disciplinary measure may request reconsideration once in writing within seven days of receiving notice.

studentActions.name: Pohang University of Science And Technology (POSTECH)

scope.en: POSTECH baseline: AI permissions depend on individual course syllabi; library database tools provide research support but not exam permission; students are advised against entering personal data; research ethics regulations limit authorship to natural persons; commercial procurement agreements remain an unverified gap.
scope.zh: 浦项科技大学基准：AI使用许可因课程而异；图书馆检索工具仅供学术支持而非考试许可；建议防范个人数据泄露；科研伦理规范限制作者须为自然人；商业采购协议待核验。

coursework.en: POSTECH Library learner guidelines specify that generative AI permission varies by course; students must verify each syllabus and cannot assume blanket permission.
coursework.zh: 浦项科技大学图书馆学习指南明确说明：生成式AI的使用权限因课程而异，学生必须查阅各科教学大纲，不得擅自默认可以使用。
coursework.meaningEn: Individual course syllabi and library guidance
coursework.meaningZh: 各科教学大纲与图书馆学生指南

exams.en: POSTECH academic dishonesty rules list having another person sit an examination and sharing or copying examination answers among prohibited acts. Check the course’s specific AI rules separately.
exams.zh: POSTECH学术不端规则列举的禁止行为包括请他人代考以及在考试中展示或抄看答案；具体AI使用规则须另查课程要求。
exams.meaningEn: Academic regulations and proctored exam rules
exams.meaningZh: 校级考纪条例与考场纪律规范

disclosure.en: Library guidance says that when AI is quoted in formal writing, such as a research paper, the AI citation must be included.
disclosure.zh: 图书馆指引规定，在研究论文等正式写作中引用AI内容时，必须注明AI引用信息。
disclosure.meaningZh: 图书馆学术规范与全校引注要求

privacy_data.en: Library guidance warns that entering personal details such as names or phone numbers into AI can expose them to others and advises care with personal information security.
privacy_data.zh: 图书馆指引提醒，向AI输入姓名或电话号码等个人信息可能泄露给他人，应注意个人信息安全。
privacy_data.meaningZh: 图书馆学习者信息安全警示

approved_tools.en: POSTECH Library provides academic search and discovery services including Primo Research Assistant; campus-wide enterprise AI licensing or a centralized multi-LLM platform remains an unverified gap.

do.en: Consult each course syllabus before using generative AI in assignments or projects.
do.zh: 在作业或项目中使用生成式AI前，务必先查阅各门课程的具体大纲要求。

do.en: When quoting AI in formal writing such as a research paper, include the AI citation.
do.zh: 在研究论文等正式写作中引用AI内容时，注明AI引用信息。

dont.en: Take care with personal information security: entering names or phone numbers into AI can expose them to others.
dont.zh: 注意个人信息安全：向AI输入姓名或电话号码可能泄露给他人。

dont.en: Do not assume that access to library research tools authorizes AI use in an examination; check the course rules.
dont.zh: 不要以能访问图书馆研究工具推断考试中获准使用AI；应核对课程规则。

cl-pohang-university-of-science-and-tech.text: DBpia AI Service is listed for Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH) in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.

evidence.quote: POSTECH Library's guide lists DBpia AI Service among AI features available in Library databases. It states that personalized service is available after login with monthly usage limits, including AI Search, idea assistance and AI Viewer/chat features.

cl-pohang-university-of-science-and-tech.text: OED AI Search Assistant (Beta) is listed for Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH) in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: not mentioned. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.

evidence.quote: POSTECH Library's guide lists OED AI Search Assistant (Beta) among AI features available in Library databases and directs users to the Oxford English Dictionary AI search feature.

cl-pohang-university-of-science-and-tech.text: Oxford University Press Journals AI Discovery Assistant (Beta) is listed for Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH) in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: not mentioned. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.

evidence.quote: POSTECH Library's guide lists Oxford University Press Journals AI Discovery Assistant (Beta) among AI features available in Library databases. It says prompts return ten journal-content results with AI-generated summaries and source links.

cl-pohang-university-of-science-and-tech.text: AI-based Paper Search (Primo Research Assistant) is listed for Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH) in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: not mentioned. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.

evidence.quote: POSTECH Library's guide lists AI-based Paper Search (Primo Research Assistant) among AI features available in Library databases. It says the service answers a research question using reliable sources and provides a summarized answer with its five most relevant cited sources.

cl-pohang-university-of-science-and-tech.text: ScienceON AI is listed for Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH) in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.

evidence.quote: POSTECH Library's guide lists ScienceON AI among AI features available in Library databases. It says individual membership registration and login are required to use its AI-Helper summaries and AI-Reviewer functions.

cl-pohang-university-of-science-and-tech.text: Statista Research AI (Beta) is listed for Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH) in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: not mentioned. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.

evidence.quote: POSTECH Library's guide lists Statista Research AI (Beta) among AI features available in Library databases. It says the Research AI tab provides a summary with sentence-level citations, source viewing and suggested searches.

cl-pohang-university-of-science-and-tech.text: WIPSON AI Search is listed for Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH) in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.

evidence.quote: POSTECH Library's guide lists WIPSON AI Search among AI features available in Library databases. It requires users to check Library database guidance and register for an account before use, and describes similar-document extraction and automatic translation search.

claim-postech-ai-service-models-data.text: POSTECH describes POSTECH AI as a multi-LLM generative AI service for members that includes ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude, and says entered user data is designed not to be used for external model retraining.

evidence.quote: 포스텍 구성원을 위한 멀티 LLM 기반 생성형 AI 서비스 'POSTECH AI'은 단순한 질의응답 서비스를 넘어섭니다. 이 플랫폼은 ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude 등 세계 최고 수준의 모델을 한곳에 담아, 사용자가 연구와 업무 목적에 따라 최적의 모델을 선택할 수 있는 폭넓은 환경을 제공합니다. 그뿐 아니라 사용자가 입력한 데이터가 외부 모델의 재학습에 절대 활용되지 않도록 설계되었습니다.

claim-postech-ai-native-initiative.text: POSTECH announced an AI-Native University initiative with Microsoft and described it as integrating AI across admissions, student education, research, and administration.

evidence.quote: POSTECH의 'AI-Native University' 전환은 기존의 부분적 AI 활용과는 차원이 다른 개념이다. 우리나라 대학 최초로 입시, 학생 교육, 연구, 행정까지 대학 운영 전반에 AI를 통합하는 포괄적 접근이 핵심이다.
evidence.location: Article body, paragraphs after MOU announcement

claim-postech-ai-governance-security.text: POSTECH says it discussed data security, data sovereignty, operating structure, scalability, and governance before later implementation tasks including POSTECH AI.

evidence.quote: MOU 체결 이후 포스텍은 AI를 대학 전반에 내재화하기 위해 필요한 데이터 보안과 주권, 그리고 운영 및 확장 구조에 대해 심도 있게 논의해 왔습니다. 이는 AI가 대학의 교육·연구·행정 전반의 데이터를 다룰 때 어떤 원칙과 책임 체계 아래 움직여야 하는지 점검하는 과정이었습니다. 기술을 도입하기 전, 그 기술이 안전하고 책임감 있게 작동할 수 있는 거버넌스(Governance)를 먼저 다진 것입니다. 이는 이후 POSTECH AI 오픈을 포함한 여러 실행 과제들의 기준점이 되었습니다.
